messages.author: eecaf81870fd3920
messages.subject: Missing MVPA data only
parts:
Hi all,

I am looking at physical activity data. I am using Axivity AX6 accelerometers and two RStudio scripts to process the data. I have used the scripts to good effect, having processed around 700 pieces of individual data. I run two scripts, the first processes the data using a study specific version of the GGIR script for PA. The second extracts specific data relevant to the study, including calibration error, measurement duration, wear duration (minimum 3day validation criteria), intensity gradient, mean acceleration, sleep duration, inactive minutes, light intensity activity, vigorous intensity activity and moderate to vigorous intensity activity. These data are sourced from part 2 / 4 / 5 GGIR script output files. 

I ran both scripts today and found something I have not encountered before. One participant met the validation wear time criteria, had data for intensity gradient, mean acceleration, inactive activity and light intensity activity,  however there were no data for sleep duration, vigorous intensity activity nor MVPA (i.e.., the columns were blank). MVPA is our primary outcome for the trial and so important. I looked into this and the participant did not wear the accelerometer at night, so I can understand why the sleep column was blank, however they had wore the accelerometer during the day on 4 days meeting the validation criteria, resulting in some PA data being included in the output. I then looked at the raw part2 summary files where the relevant data were sourced from and this participants data were blank in both the vigorous and MVPA columns. 

Does anyone know why these columns would be blank? Is there a work around? I imagine not, but I would be keen to understand why we are missing primary outcome data for this participant, especially when the output did include intensity gradient, mean acceleration (both also taken from part2 summary file), inactive minutes and light intensity minutes. 

To be specific, we used the following items for the output:
  • Vigorous intensity: part2_summary / Column RE / AD_MVPA_E5S_B1M80._T400_ENMO_0.24hr 
  • MVPA:  part2_summary / Column QS / AD_MVPA_E5S_B1M80._T100_ENMO_0.24hr
I look forward to hearing others thoughts on this.

Many thanks,

Gareth
